Once a puppetmaster from abroad, Anton Volkov now spends significant amounts of time within the German Democratic Republic, drifting between East Berlin and the Stralsund waterfront. Prostitution rings, drug trafficking, weapons sales: few underground markets have gone unmarked by his hand. 

His name in the encrypted Perseus dossier must have significance.
hash_3973504a573114ab:
Franz Kraus has been under the microscope of MI6 for two years now, ever since an agent recorded him during surveillance of Leon "Six Fingers" Dubray. The focus of attention immediately changed from Dubray to Kraus.

(translated from German)
"If you think I'm going to [unintelligible] my son by going around Volkov, you're insane. Find yourself another lawyer."
hash_596536d3c09af580: This is a recently acquired blueprint of Franz Kraus's apartment near the Wall in East Berlin. If the meeting between Kraus and Anton Volkov goes as expected, it might not be necessary. However, the team needs to be ready for all contingencies. If the Central Intelligence Agency needs additional intel within Kraus's home, they will be ready.

In the case of the East Berlin mission, he recommends keeping one handy during infiltration into the city, in the event that the team needs to trail Anton Volkov or Franz Kraus into a tight environment with innocent bystanders present.
hash_33c783b07898571e:
According to a recent column from a West Berlin newspaper, the frequency of border crossings between East and West Berlin has recently increased, with many attempts exploiting the underground tunnels of the U-Bahn train network. 

The vulnerability of that system is the reason Adler and his team plan to use it to get across the Wall. Even with the increased police presence in the closed stations, careful planning should allow access to East Berlin without conflict.

hash_40f074e3ffd8bff0:
The government east of the Wall has issued a stark declaration: anyone caught sneaking into the country illegally will be shot on site. Trespassers should not expect advance warnings if caught.

The message hasn't changed since 1945, but the Soviets have chosen to reiterate it in light of recent "enemies of the state" operating within their borders.

In February of 1980, the Stasi detained and arrested a suspected foreign agent conducting illegal communications inside his apartment with a contact in West Berlin, according to an official statement by Stasi Lieutenant Leipzig. Despite the seemingly mundane contents of the communications, he was ultimately sentenced to several decades in prison. The identity and nationality of the perpetrator have not been released.

Paranoia within Soviet ranks has only grown with the recent inauguration of United States President, Ronald Reagan. A  change in Western leadership brings new concerns to the East, although to this point none of their reactions appear based on specific policy actions. The Soviets solely [cut off]

The German Democratic Republic continues to be one of the most loyal allies of the USSR. After the recent arrest of thirteen teenagers who were using the U-Bahn's underground tunnel system to cross the border, the KGB has elevated their own presence by tenfold.

The KGB has shown itself willing to employ extreme and sometimes peculiar tactics (e.g. the "Romeo Escapades") as the Soviet Union continues to push back on the West by whatever means it deems necessary. Many have expressed anxiety that the increase in Soviet intervention will increase tension and violence on both sides of the Berlin Wall.

The dark shadow of the Iron Curtain will continue to loom heavily over West Berlin. If the Soviets continue to suspect Western interference on their side of the divide, a split Germany could soon become [cut off]

hash_71e10734e5898a8f:
From what the UK's Military Intelligence, Section 6 (MI6) has gathered, Franz Kraus is one of Anton Volkov's key pawns in East Berlin. Kraus lives and works close to the Wall, often passing back and forth between East and West Berlin. Presumably he is Volkov's chief courier of information and cash.

Kraus grew up in Dresden before relocating to Paris for a decade after graduation. Apparently his chief aspiration was to make a respected name for himself, but during that period MI6 believes Kraus first became involved in organized crime. In 1972 he returned to Germany, where he has remained ever since, falling further into darkness.
hash_1066bb1e7ac117f4:
One of Jason Hudson's East Berlin assets, Greta Keller, has informed the team of an opportunity to get to Anton Volkov. According to a source within Greta's network, Volkov is scheduled to meet with Franz Kraus at a bar several blocks away from Kraus's apartment.

Greta will arrive incognito at the bar in advance, where she will give the team any additional information she has to share.
hash_605f625a1e621c80:
One morning in early January 1968, MACV-SOG Operator Lawrence Sims left Da Nang Air Base with USAF Airman Darren Kopp for a routine recon mission. After experiencing mechanical difficulties, their chopper touched down in a jungle clearing fifteen miles outside the base. 

While waiting for assistance, they were ambushed by Viet Cong and forced to flee into the jungle. Kopp was killed in combat. Sims, ammo exhausted, took Kopp's knife and circled the clearing perimeter. He managed to take out three soldiers by hand before reinforcements arrived and secured the malfunctioning chopper.

Sims never parted with the knife after that incident. It now hangs from the board as a good luck charm.
hash_5033e4b1043a1d4a: Sometimes you need more than your wits.
hash_426fe562d9b68c4d:
After Lawrence Sims graduated from Rochester Institute of Technology, he entered the Army, where he served for two years before joining the ranks of the Central Intelligence Agency. 

His first major assignment placed him on Russell Adler's MACV-SOG team in Vietnam, where he immediately became one of Adler's favorite cohorts. By the end of their time there, Sims was also Adler's most trusted confidante. He has been a mainstay on Adler's various teams ever since.
hash_791ca0be4954c495: Photo of Russell Adler and Lawrence Sims
hash_6cb7af24c08ca81a:
Located just north of Da Nang, Camp Haskins was part of a conglomeration of US military bases that supported the Army, Marines, Navy, and Air Force. 

Russell Adler's MACV-SOG team was briefly stationed there in the fall of 1967 and into the early winter of 1968. This photo was taken on a rare day without rain during the region's winter monsoon season. It was during this week at Da Nang that Adler's team discovered evidence of Perseus activity in Vietnam.
hash_78db32bb4350b18f: The events in Da Nang during January 1968 revealed an embarrassing vulnerability in the Fracture Jaw plan. It was immediately scrapped before any additional damage could be done.
hash_708473fda4e2ced1:
The Studies and Observation Group (MACV-SOG), began covert missions in Vietnam in 1964. In July 1967, Russell Adler and his small team of MACV-SOG operatives were sent by the Central Intelligence Agency to the Quang Nam Province in central Vietnam. 

While training and often operating alongside the other battalions that moved in and out of the area over the months, Adler's group always had an ear to the ground, listening for any word of Soviet activity. When a viable rumor appeared, they would move on their own to investigate. It wasn't until January 1968 that the CIA finally confirmed the presence of Perseus.
hash_3ac1af36d65f7e1e: As the fortunes of US military in Vietnam declined, senior military officers, including General William Westmoreland, began to enact a top secret plan: the deployment of tactical nuclear weapons in Vietnam. Perseus learned of this plan, codenamed Fracture Jaw, as well as the storage location of one of the first bombs sent into the country.
hash_1f5c97c675545400: Keeping one's weapon out of another's hands.
hash_2d4f62fa9d0dc704:
The Central Intelligence Agency knows little of the figure it has dubbed "Perseus". Records of his actions date back to the end of World War 2, and suspected appearances are documented up through the Vietnam War; after that, only silence. This photo is the only clear likeness in the Agency's archives. Analysts estimate its date from the mid to late 1950s.

Interestingly, sometime around that same period the elusive Soviet operative began to refer to himself using the Perseus moniker, perhaps as a point of pride. Or was it a mocking nod to his pursuers?
hash_4ccfce09b7f2d421:
After Russell Adler's confrontation with Arash Kadivar, analysis of Trabzon Airfield revealed that Kadivar may have been moving weapons to Perseus. It is speculation though, as the recipient and destination remain unclear. 

What is clear is that Kadivar is somehow connected to Perseus, and Kadivar appeared to have knowledge of an impending attack of ambiguous nature.
hash_73121ff71eeaabae: This mission authorization telegram was sent to Russell Adler from Emerson Black, the Deputy Strategist within the CIA's Directorate of Operations.
hash_6b1a6cc36a033300:
"Mr. Adler,

By direct authorization of the President, we are pleased to grant you and your team an unconditional license to conduct clandestine operations in pursuit of Perseus, on both domestic and foreign soil. As previously noted, our preference is for apprehension of the target; otherwise terminate. Jason Hudson will provide material support and intelligence from the Agency as needed. Do not hesitate to keep him fully informed of day to day operations. While I understand his concerns about your unorthodox team construction, and the inherent volatility in such an arrangement, be assured that you will be given the opportunity to prove yourself.

On a personal note, the President expressed to me his utmost faith in your capabilities. The stakes of the current situation need not be repeated.

Deputy Strategist, Directorate of Operations
Emerson Black"
hash_d25797bbcac0fbb:
This is the dossier &&1 "Bell" &&2 recovered in the village outside of the firebase Ripcord in Vietnam. Rumors had already placed Perseus in that area of Da Nang, and it was a stroke of fortune that Bell stumbled upon it. 

The Central Intelligence Agency attempted to decipher the dossier, but it proved impenetrable. Now that Russell Adler has brought it out of the archives, Bell's decryption efforts have yielded a present day lead: Anton Volkov of East Berlin.
hash_67e6e1c982af1bd0: The team acquired this photo in East Berlin during the mission to apprehend or eliminate Anton Volkov. The Central Intelligence Agency suspects that Volkov was smuggling this device through the city, presumably to turn over to Perseus, who has long coveted a nuclear weapon of his own.
hash_434ed97e9bdd251d:
Perseus discovered, and exploited, a CIA program that not even Russell Adler and his team were aware of. Jason Hudson is one of the leaders of Operation Greenlight, a covert program that placed strategic US nuclear devices in European cities. Greenlight is a last ditch effort to prevent the Soviets from invading Europe, but its execution would carry a terrible price.

With the help of Anton Volkov, Perseus stole one of the Greenlight nukes from West Berlin and moved it to a still unknown location. The prospect of Perseus possessing an American nuclear device is terrifying for Western security.
hash_afcf6730d04c3ea:
Perseus downloaded materials from the mainframe at Mount Yamantau, then promptly deleted them. Once the mainframe was transported back to Langley, the Central Intelligence Agency analyzed it, but very little of value could be recovered. The CIA managed to acquire a partial list of code names, but none of the real names associated with those aliases.

Despite the sabotage by Perseus, the CIA now knows what he is after: the sleeper agents that Nikita Dravovich once planned to use for his own attack on the United States thirteen years ago.
hash_4b5d628fc64d46e7:
Thanks to a daring infiltration of the KGB's headquarters, the Central Intelligence Agency now possesses an unredacted list of the sleeper agents Nikita Dragovich conditioned within the United States in the 1960s.

Perseus has his sights on Theodore Hastings, a nuclear engineer involved with Operation Greenlight.

Frank Woods grabbed this VHS tape from within the base, among a batch of other similarly labeled tapes.

The video contains a series of military exercises executed within the recreated US section of the base: chopper infiltrations, storefront breaches, as well as hostage taking maneuvers within various interior environments.
hash_7bb885dc1b062442: Don't be a Red, rewind instead.
hash_28c4a227cc2347a0: VHS Tape of Soviet Military Exercises
hash_40e14d00089e4d39: At Frank Woods's insistence, Bell carried several rolls of film into the mission and captured a number of valuable shots for the Central Intelligence Agency.
hash_3daf7f3fd3d085d7:
Frank Woods strikes again. Woods first claimed that he took these promotional keychains in the "high likelihood" that they contained Soviet tracking devices. Then he told everyone that they were souvenirs for Lazar Azoulay. 

But everyone on the team knows the real reason: the soft spot Woods holds in his heart for a greasy Burger Town cheeseburger and fries.
hash_5c310f1dbc77303c: A critical piece of mission planning is ensuring that all possible variables are accounted for in advance. This piece of CIA intel is an example of that research. An analysis of climate trends in the area around the mission target helped the team plan the infiltration route as well as the range of gear they carried in.
hash_25a6d7f368451e0d:
The front entrance to the base was manned, but the Soviet guards stationed there seemed only partially invested in the job. It was dark outside, the base was deep in the Ukraine forest, and in all likelihood past incidents had been practically nonexistent.

The conditions were set for Frank Woods and Bell to take the guards out with minimal resistance or alarm.
hash_2fcb7bc56870b5da:
After analyzing overhead recon photos, the team sat down and worked through numerous sketches of infiltration plans.

In the end, Frank Woods insisted on going through the "front door", as opposed to cutting through a position on the perimeter.
hash_133d61630212bdb8: The team was not expecting a recreation of an American town on the inside of the giant structure. Another secret of the cold war revealed.
hash_5a3cbd5915d1f403: After the team discovered encrypted geocoordinates inside of Anton Volkov's seized materials, Jason Hudson called in an aerial reconnaissance run over the identified area. The resulting image revealed a mysterious base dominated by a large structure in the center.
hash_4e5e3d39bb18cb9e:
The Lubyanka building is located on Lubyanka Square in Moscow, a short walk from Red Square and the Kremlin. Constructed in 1898, it became the headquarters of the secret police, or Cheka, following the Bolshevik Revolution. It currently serves as the headquarters of the KGB, Cheka's successor.

Russell Adler and Bell will reach the perimeter of the building via a series of underground tunnels which connect the surrounding streets and squares. Once they are in position, Dimitri Belikov will unlock the final security door connecting the tunnels to Lubyanka proper.
hash_560c7365be6fd9cd:
When the Central Intelligence Agency needs the services of Dimitri Belikov, they usually ask him to provide sensitive information. For this high stakes mission, Belikov will need to do more than that; he will need to get Russell Adler and Bell a keycard for the underground bunker which houses the classified information they seek.

One of the first orders of business will be for Belikov to turn off the main camera system. Covering his own tracks will be the key to success.
hash_543d27a545f59a: This small device has been engineered to release an incapacitating gas agent known as CARYOPH-3 with explosive force. It is ideal for placement within constricted spaces, such as luggage, briefcases, and in the case of this mission, ductwork.
hash_73fbf05d031b6a00: This is a classified Soviet letter recently acquired by Dimitri Belikov. In the letter, the head of the KGB, Yuri Andropov, writes to General Secretary Brezhnev about recent concerns regarding unauthorized communications within the KGB.
hash_1c144fe73f127092:
Dear General Secretary Brezhnev,

I understand your concern regarding recent reports of unauthorized communications originating within KGB headquarters. Please be assured that all efforts are underway to not only decrypt these communications, but to establish whether the KGB is indeed the source of said communications. Our current belief is that the timing of the incident at Yamantau and the most recent anomalous transmission is coincidental. 

Regarding the matter at Yamantau, we are still working to establish the identities of the responsible parties.

If you are still interested in sending another representative from the Central Committee to discuss in person, we will schedule this at your convenience. As I mentioned before, we have asked both Colonel Lev Kravchenko as well as Head of Security, Colonel Dimitri Belikov to investigate these reports. In our previous correspondence you mentioned a preference for bringing an additional investigator in. I am of course more than willing to accommodate your request if this remains your desire.

Looking forward to your reply,
Chairman of the Committee for State Security
Yuri Andropov
hash_79b4b263e29bcff9:
In the Chronicle article titled "Brezhnev Proposes Renovations for Lubyanka Square District", the author discusses plans to update the architecture of KGB Headquarters and the surrounding area, possibly as soon as 1983. One of the reasons cited is to preserve the structural integrity of the building, which stands upon a cavernous world.

Beneath the Square are a series of old tunnels dating back to the 19th century. In one particular spot, there is a direct connection between these tunnels and the bunker lying beneath the Lubyanka Building. Russell Adler and Bell, with Dimitri Belikov's assistance, plan to infiltrate the building at this nexus.
hash_401c1aaa97d7aeaf:
Leonid Brezhnev has proposed renovations for the Lubyanka Square and surrounding structures. He also suggested that the Lubyanka Building merge with other related structures constructed over the last several decades, and that the facade be unified following Alexey Shchusev's original 1940 vision for the building's expansion.

A motivating factor in the renovations is the increasing instability of the Lubyanka Building's foundation. One of the potential causes of instability is the presence of the Moscow Metro beneath Lubyanka Square. There is also an older series of tunnels beneath the Square, which dates back to 1898, the year the Lubyanka Building was constructed. These tunnels are still intact, but see very little maintenance or traversal.
hash_bee6cf06ac03174: Renovations Most Likely Planned for Early 1983

hash_3a3fb663dab452c6:
Major Dimitri Belikov is the most valuable CIA asset within the KGB. He is the key to getting Russell Adler and Bell into the Lubyanka building, where Belikov currently serves as the Head of Security.

In the 1960s, Belikov participated in a number of clandestine Soviet operations in Czechoslovakia, Jordan, and Mongolia. At the end of the decade he was briefly involved in a program to train North Vietnamese pilots to fly Soviet helicopters, an initiative whose support eventually waned.

It was late 1967 when Belikov came into contact with a CIA operative in Laos, a meeting which would forever change his perspective and allegiances. This path eventually led him to Jason Hudson, who would serve as Belikov's CIA contact moving forward. A patient investment of fourteen years is finally coming to fruition.
hash_7c7eec5861838e44:
Dimitri Belikov has falsified a maintenance order for part of the ventilation system in the Lubyanka Building. In advance of servicemen who will never arrive, security will unlock a critical section of ductwork in the bunker of the building. Russell Adler and Bell will pass it on their way to the vault holding the sleeper agent information.

The access panel will allow the team to plant a small explosive with CARYOPH-3, an incapacitation agent, into the ventilation system. The gas will then be capable of spreading throughout the subterranean portion of the building.
hash_6df2d7174fc101ee:
As the current Head of Security for KGB Headquarters, Dimitri Belikov has intimate access to the comings and goings of most of the denizens within the Lubyanka Building.

Even with this valuable information, the mission is extremely risky due to the likelihood of unforeseen events. Unfortunately there is little time to iron out the most ideal timing for the operation; it must be done as soon as possible.
hash_1d94c09e33929cb0: His finger on the pulse of Lubyanka.
hash_2dadd3e32ce4abb4:
Major General Nikita Dragovich spent over a decade trying to recreate a Nazi chemical weapon, Nova 6, that he had discovered on a German freighter in 1945. Within a facility on Mount Yamantau he eventually succeeded, weaponizing it for an intended attack on the United States.

He planned to release the Nova 6 gas via brainwashed agents strategically positioned across America, who awaited an activation signal. It never arrived, thanks to the intervention of the Central Intelligence Agency.

Dragovich was one of the most feared figures within the Soviet military before his death at the hands of Alex Mason thirteen years ago. Thanks to the actions of Perseus, Dragovich's legacy continues to endanger global security.
hash_6df05697d320c791:
Much of the Soviet base at Mount Yamantau was destroyed in early 1968, but the Central Intelligence Agency did manage to acquire a few small items from the site. Dragovich and his scientists had been using integrated circuits of an advanced and previously unknown design in his pursuit of Nova 6 weaponization. 

Every advantage helps in the cold war between the United States and the Soviet Union, and the United States can ill afford to allow the Soviets to get a leg up in any technological arena.
hash_4bb9a4cb6076c8de:
In 1968, CIA agents confiscated this intact reel of magnetic tape from the ruins of the Soviet base at Mount Yamantau. It contains a series of test results from late 1966 related to the development of the chemical weapon, Nova 6. 

Within large mainframes like the one recovered by Frank Woods, Alex Mason, and Dimitri Belikov, reels provide the ability to store massive amounts of data. Magnetic storage technology is still the storage standard for high capacity needs, with improvements arriving on a regular basis.
hash_57e22a0a3b03ca6b:
At first, Major Dimitri Belikov balked when Jason Hudson wanted his assistance in planning an approach on Mount Yamantau. Belikov would need to put himself at risk just to pry into the nature of a Soviet operation there. After some investigation, all he could find was confirmation that someone sought a buried mainframe there, for undisclosed reasons.

When he learned the Central Intelligence Agency's plan, Belikov volunteered to fly Frank Woods and Alex Mason to Mount Yamantau himself. He longed for an any excuse to fly again, and the fact that the CIA needed to airlift a mainframe right out of the facility was a detail Belikov could not resist.
hash_737ee4ba74dc7340:
This photo was taken by CIA Operative Grigori Weaver in 1968 while on a mission with Jason Hudson to investigate a secret Soviet military facility at Mount Yamantau.

A control room within the base prominently displayed a map of the United States. The map showed areas within the United States that Nikita Dragovich intended to hit during his chemical weapon attack. Once the sleeper agents in each of those regions received an activation signal, they would release Nova 6 gas to catastrophic effect. Fortunately, Dragovich was never able to execute on his plan.
hash_2c44acfbaf22ff0d:
"The suspected presence of a sleeper cell network has recently compromised national security. This network was established under the guidance of the recently deceased Soviet Major General Nikita Dragovich. Dragovich\xe2\x80\x99s plan to activate the agents was thwarted on 02.16, but the identities of the agents remain largely unknown. At the moment it is believed that many, if not all, of these agents have undergone extensive brainwashing treatments and may not be aware of their own status as Soviet assets. Unless these agents are rooted out, they may pose an ongoing threat to the nation in the event that something triggers the conditioning already in place.

Efforts are underway to track down existing agents, but we must advise caution and tempered expectations about whether success is achievable. Several suspected agents were recently swept up in [REDACTED], but without evidence, and without the suspects possessing knowledge of [END OF PAGE]".
hash_6c1d0b37a02d2345: "Soviet Sleeper Agent Infiltration Within the United States"
hash_366950cdaf4e96da:
The Urals are a range of mountains roughly 1600 miles long that bisect the Soviet Union from north to south, extending from the Arctic Ocean to the Kazakh Steppe. Many consider it the geographical division between Asia and Europe.

The Central Intelligence Agency has had its eyes on activity in the region for decades, due to its strategic properties and available natural resources. In 1959, the CIA discovered evidence of a nuclear accident at the foothills of the Urals, near Chelyabinsk Oblast, its scope making it the largest nuclear disaster in history. The USSR has not acknowledged the accident, nor is its existence generally known outside of classified intelligence.

At some point in the 1960s, construction began on a secret military facility at Mount Yamantau, one of the highest peaks in the chain. In February 1968 Jason Hudson led a team of operatives to Yamantau to investigate the possible production of a chemical weapon there, Nova 6.

hash_14c125f0ebfb57d4:
Robert Aldrich represents one of the worst case scenarios for the Central Intelligence Agency: a highly trained operative who, through either greed, vindictiveness, or just a profound shift in world view, turns his power against the organization and country that shaped him.

Once that line has been crossed, there's no turning back. His elimination is the only way to ensure the future security of the nation.
hash_77c49f5f174765dd: Sims: "The lead agents have been exchanging information with the KGB through a series of dead drops. MI6 believes the wristwatch we recovered in the KGB contains an encoded list of recent drops. Let\xe2\x80\x99s see what you can decipher!"

hash_1f88388cdd97e16e:
According to CIA intelligence, Soviet Major Vadim Rudnik has collaborated with Perseus for several years now as they work to install agents within the political infrastructures of Europe.

Rudnik is apparently the handler for these embedded operatives, so eliminating him will disrupt whatever long term plans Perseus has in mind.
hash_b1ac650df204264:
Arash Kadivar was born moments after the Allied invasion of Iran on August 25th, 1941. As Kadivar neared his twelth birthday, the Prime Minister of Iran was overthrown in a Western sponsored coup. Kadivar's father, a supporter of Mohammad Mosaddegh's regime, was imprisoned, tortured, and summarily executed.

The young Kadivar entered his teenage years with a powerful anti-imperialist anger. Later he would begin to reluctantly associate with agents of the USSR, who also had an interest in ousting the American-backed Shah.

Kadivar showed himself capable of exploiting religious zealotry if it served his political purposes. It is unknown when his relationship with Perseus began, but Russell Adler ended it on the tarmac at Trabzon Airfield.
hash_5e1f8ec311ca5a66: A key Middle Eastern asset for Perseus?
hash_418a87e5c8c09d81:
Qasim Javadi was born in northwest Iran in 1946, inside the short-lived USSR puppet state of the Azerbaijan People's Government. He grew up in poverty but showed exceptional promise as a student. At age 18 he left his family to attend the University of Tehran, intent on becoming a doctor, but dropped out dissatisfied. Qasim became increasingly attracted to the political resistance movement in Iran.

After encountering Arash Kadivar at a secret group meet-up in Tehran, Qasim entered the fold, becoming a key ally in Kadivar's plan to undermine the government of the Shah.

Javadi's arrogance, love of luxury, and carelessness left him vulnerable to CIA action once they chose to take it.
hash_6bdd1c268dc4278e:
After killing Arash Kadivar, Russell Adler's team discovered that Kadivar had been moving crates of black market 1911s out of Turkey to an unknown destination. 

A partially destroyed manifest acquired on the scene of the plane crash mentioned "Woodpecker", which could be the codename of the recipient or location.
hash_5df2d64bb3bc229b:
As Russell Adler, Frank Woods, and Alex Mason watched from a hidden location, Arash Kadivar decided to execute someone on the tarmac at Trabzon Airfield. It is possible the victim was an unaffiliated third party, but the Central Intelligence Agency believes that it was more likely an internal dispute of some kind.

Based on the .45 bullet extracted from the victim's chest, Kadivar was using a 1911 from the illicit weapons shipment loaded on a nearby plane.
hash_10599ee55e248fb0:
In Turkey, the Central Intelligence Agency seized several items from Arash Kadivar's person, including his eyeglasses. After a laboratory analysis, investigators discovered a narrow compartment embedded in the underside of the left lens frame.

A curved, hollow needle containing a small dose of tetrodotoxin, a powerful neurotoxin, was nestled inside the hidden compartment. Analysts speculate that Kadivar could have been carrying the toxin to either evade capture through suicide, or to use as an additional close quarters weapon if otherwise disarmed.
hash_70c25f0a27b019ca:
Qasim Javadi purchased this apartment in cash less than a year ago, which exactly no one within the Central Intelligence Agency believed was a clean transaction.

Javadi had been partying with friends, family, and cohorts in a seemingly endless New Years celebration when Russell Adler and company decided to make a surprise appearance. Many of the men there would be practiced militants, but for the most part Adler expected it to be a simple affair. He wasn't wrong.
hash_5515337276a6aa44: Lifestyles of the rich and infamous.
hash_7bbf4fb093381ec7:
As Russell Adler prepared to leave Langley in late January, he briefly discussed his plans with Lawrence Sims to resurrect the old CIA evidence board at safehouse E9 in West Berlin, starting with intel from their recently completed missions in Amsterdam and Trabzon. 

Frank Woods, who was listening nearby, walked up to Adler and placed a hand on his shoulder. Woods lifted up a matchbook from the bar in Amsterdam and waved it front of Adler's face. Leaning toward Adler with a serious look, he said, "Hey. A souvenir for your fuckin' board."

Who is Adler to disappoint?
hash_4fe55f05b899982c:
Hans Timmerman is the chief of police in Amsterdam-Centrum, the historical heart of Amsterdam, Netherlands. In 1976, Russell Adler first met him at a late night poker game in Newmarket, where Adler not only took most of Timmerman's money, but also a mental snapshot of all of Timmerman's weaknesses. 

These included, but were not limited to, American dollars, fantasies about international espionage, and an irrational fear of exotic foreigners. He was just the man to exploit when Adler needed to remove the police presence from the area around Qasim Javadi's apartment.

It would be a clear path from the back of De Stier to Qasim's courtyard, and a short window of time to go weapons free without fear of intervention.

Sims: "So, listen up. An ex-CIA operative named Robert Aldrich has gone rogue. Langley believes this asshole is working with Perseus to assemble a spy ring inside US borders.

We recently acquired an encrypted floppy disk from one of his agents that we believe contains everything we need to know about his network. If we can get to it."

We know where Aldrich is and can move on him anytime, but if we don\xe2\x80\x99t get into this disk first... we may nail Aldrich but leave his network intact.

You may find some intel out on missions that could help crack the code on this disk. Keep an eye out."
hash_25a986dad8f82f49:
Sims: "MI6 has spent the last year tracking a group of embedded Soviet agents within multiple European governments.

These agents could be strategically positioned to set up a larger Soviet plan for Europe.

During a recent operation we acquired information about this group\xe2\x80\x99s structure. There are three unidentified key agents leading it, and their handler is the Soviet Major Vadim Rudnik, a name previously connected to Perseus.

We have Rudnik\xe2\x80\x99s position and can move on him, but if we don\xe2\x80\x99t first identify his three lead agents we risk losing our chance to take all of the embedded agents down.

Check out our list of suspects here. Special evidence you find on missions will help identify the three lead agents. I\xe2\x80\x99d advise figuring out who they are before going after Rudnik."
